text:
- United Kingdom generated £89.8k revenue TW, representing 86.5% of total sales and demonstrating dominant market position.
- Total revenue reached £103.7k TW but declined 12.1% WoW from £118.0k LW, indicating a significant weekly contraction.
- Japan achieved strong growth with revenue increasing 12485.6% WoW, while maintaining 5.5% share of total sales at £5.7k TW.
- Year-over-year performance shows total revenue up 23.4% YoY from £84.1k LY, with United Kingdom contributing 20.5% YoY growth.
- Germany revenue fell 31.5% YoY to £2.8k TW, while Australia declined 60.7% YoY, indicating weakness in these markets.
- United Kingdom processed 204 orders TW from 44149 units, while Japan generated 2962 units across the portfolio.
- Netherlands revenue grew 280.4% WoW and Belgium increased 69.2% WoW, showing positive momentum in these smaller markets.
- Total order volume reached 222 orders TW with 51540 units sold across all countries.
